summary.text: Packy Campbell is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A real estate broker and homebuilder who said in a Ballotpedia survey that he previously served in the New Hampshire House from 2002 to 2006, Campbell is running on getting state education aid to the district and reducing regulatory costs for housing.

paragraphs.text: Packy Campbell graduated from Spaulding High School, earned an associate degree from the University of New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern New Hampshire University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Campbell said he was born in Strafford County in 1969, founded a construction company that has built more than 300 homes, and owns and operates RSA Realty in Rochester.
He said he has also run businesses in storage, car washes, assisted living, solar and rental and party supplies.
Campbell said he represented New Hampshire in the House from 2002 to 2006 and served on the Education Committee and the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee.

In the survey, he said he would work to make sure state education aid reaches Farmington so that the burden on local property owners falls, rather than adopting a new tax, and that he would cut regulations and fees that raise housing costs.
